events.title: July CPI report
events.why_it_matters: Most market-moving scheduled data point in the window; will shape Fed September rate decision under hawkish Chair Warsh.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI m/m at 0.2% or higher could trigger hawkish repricing and September hike odds.

events.title: July PPI report
events.why_it_matters: Producer inflation feeds into Fed policy expectations and corporate margin outlooks.
events.what_to_watch: Pipeline inflation pressures from tariffs and energy costs.

events.title: Weekly jobless claims
events.why_it_matters: Claims below 200K for 3 straight weeks (longest streak since 1969) signal tight labor market supporting hawkish Fed.
events.what_to_watch: Any break above 200K signals labor market cooling.

events.title: July Retail Sales
events.why_it_matters: Key read on US consumer health ahead of Walmart and Target earnings.
events.what_to_watch: Ex-auto/ex-gas core measure; tariff pass-through effects.

events.title: University of Michigan sentiment (Aug prelim)
events.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations component is a closely watched Fed input.
events.what_to_watch: 1-year inflation expectations — elevated readings support hawkish Fed.

events.title: FOMC July meeting minutes
events.why_it_matters: Will reveal the 9–3 vote split details and Chair Warsh's thinking on rate path.
events.what_to_watch: Any signals on September hike probability (markets currently ~1/3 odds).

events.title: Housing starts/permits (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing sector health under elevated rates.
events.what_to_watch: Rate sensitivity and affordability signals.

events.title: Existing home sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing turnover read.
events.what_to_watch: Inventory and price trends.

events.title: EIA weekly crude inventories
events.why_it_matters: Weekly crude/product data moves oil prices.
events.what_to_watch: Draws/builds amid Hormuz disruption.

events.title: Jackson Hole Economic Symposium
events.why_it_matters: Fed Chair Warsh's keynote speech is the marquee event; first Jackson Hole under his chairmanship.
events.what_to_watch: Warsh has said his speech is a 'blank piece of paper' — any signal on rate path will move markets significantly.

events.title: China LPR decision
events.why_it_matters: PBoC held rates in July after a cut; markets watching for further easing to support the economy.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PBoC cuts 1Y/5Y LPR.

events.title: China July activity data
events.why_it_matters: Retail sales, industrial production, fixed asset investment — whether stimulus is gaining traction.
events.what_to_watch: Trade surplus hit $112.5B in July (above forecasts).

events.title: Walmart Q2 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Bellwether for US consumer health and tariff impacts.
events.what_to_watch: Guidance for H2, tariff cost pass-through, e-commerce growth.

events.title: Home Depot Q2 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Housing and DIY spending read; tariff impact on building materials.
events.what_to_watch: Pro customer demand, price increases from tariffs.

events.title: Target Q2 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Discretionary spending health; Target has been underperforming on discretionary weakness.
events.what_to_watch: Same-store sales, inventory, margin recovery.

events.title: Lowe's Q2 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Housing/DIY read alongside Home Depot.
events.what_to_watch: Pro vs DIY mix, tariff impacts.

events.title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: The single most important earnings event for AI sentiment and the entire tech complex.
events.what_to_watch: Blackwell Ultra ramp, Vera Rubin timeline, AI capex guidance, China export restrictions impact.

events.title: US Section 301 semiconductor probe
events.why_it_matters: USTR investigation into Taiwan semiconductor exports (78.5% of Taiwan's outbound sales fall in targeted categories).
events.what_to_watch: Final measures and tariff levels on semiconductors.

events.title: Trump polysilicon tariff
events.why_it_matters: 15% tariff and import price floors on polysilicon products (key chip material) to challenge China.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation details and China retaliation.

events.title: US-Canada trade tensions
events.why_it_matters: Trump has threatened 50% tariffs on more Canadian goods beginning August 1.
events.what_to_watch: Escalation or de-escalation; impact on autos, lumber, energy.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz negotiations
events.why_it_matters: The strait has been effectively closed since late February, keeping Brent near $90; a deal would be a major bearish catalyst for oil.
events.what_to_watch: Any announcement of a deal — Trump said one could come 'as soon as Wednesday or Thursday.'

events.title: OPEC+ meeting
events.why_it_matters: Analysts expect no immediate changes to production policy.
events.what_to_watch: Whether OPEC+ accelerates output increases to offset Hormuz disruption.

events.title: Trilateral Mecca Defence Pact
events.why_it_matters: Regional security realignment in the Gulf.
events.what_to_watch: Implications for oil supply routes and regional stability.

events.title: US government shutdown risk
events.why_it_matters: Fiscal year ends September 30; no budget deal visible.
events.what_to_watch: September appropriations fight; shutdown risk building into late September.

events.title: Iran war (US-Israel vs Iran)
events.why_it_matters: Ongoing since February 28, 2026; cost estimated at $37.5B; keeps supply risk premium elevated.
events.what_to_watch: Hormuz deal progress, escalation risks, ceasefire prospects.

events.title: Atlantic hurricane season
events.why_it_matters: Peak hurricane season begins mid-August; Gulf of Mexico energy infrastructure at risk.
events.what_to_watch: Tropical development forecasts over next 5–7 days; NHC tracking 3 tropical waves.

events.title: South Korea semiconductor boom
events.why_it_matters: Samsung HBM4 yield near 80%, challenging SK Hynix; KOSPI had crashed ~30% in July then rebounded.
events.what_to_watch: AI memory demand sustainability, China competition.

events.title: FOMC July meeting outcome
events.why_it_matters: Fed held rates at 3.50–3.75% for 5th consecutive meeting, 9–3 vote with three dissents wanting a hike; new Chair Warsh eliminated forward guidance and signaled hawkish bias.
events.what_to_watch: Minutes (Aug 19) and Jackson Hole speech (Aug 21–23).

events.title: July jobs report
events.why_it_matters: Nonfarm payrolls fell by 23K (vs consensus +70K), unemployment at 4.2%.
events.what_to_watch: Whether jobless claims confirm continued softening.

events.title: China July trade data
events.why_it_matters: Trade surplus $112.5B, above forecasts of $107B.
events.what_to_watch: Export resilience despite tariff headwinds.

events.title: ECB July meeting outcome
events.why_it_matters: Held rates at 2.40% after June's 25bp hike; Lagarde warned energy prices could drive broader inflation.
events.what_to_watch: September meeting signals.

events.title: BOJ July meeting outcome
events.why_it_matters: Held rates at 1.00% after June's hike to 31-year high.
events.what_to_watch: Yen trajectory and further hike signals.

events.title: Senate passes Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act
events.why_it_matters: Sweeping 86-11 Senate-passed sanctions bill grants Trump authority to impose 100% tariffs on top-5 buyers of Russian oil (India, China) and renews Iran sanctions, directly threatening global oil flows and trade relations.
events.what_to_watch: House action and Trump signing; oil price reaction to potential secondary sanctions on India/China.

events.title: Trump signs executive order overhauling childhood vaccine schedule
events.why_it_matters: Executive order reduces recommended childhood vaccines from 18 to 11 diseases and splits MMR into separate shots, directly impacting vaccine manufacturers (Merck, Pfizer) and pharmacy vaccination revenue.
events.what_to_watch: Legal challenges from medical groups; CDC implementation timeline; vaccine maker earnings impact.

events.title: D.C. Circuit blocks Trump's $400M White House ballroom project
events.why_it_matters: 2-1 D.C. Circuit ruling halts construction pending congressional authorization, a significant separation-of-powers check on executive spending that Trump vows to appeal.
events.what_to_watch: Supreme Court appeal; broader implications for executive authority over federal property and spending.

events.title: SEC schedules Reg Crypto proposal vote
events.why_it_matters: SEC's first major crypto rulemaking creates safe-harbor exemptions for fundraising (up to $5M startups, $75M issuers), providing long-awaited regulatory clarity for the crypto industry.
events.what_to_watch: Vote outcome; comment period length; impact on crypto issuers, exchanges, and institutional adoption.

events.title: White House revives effort to remove Fed Governor Lisa Cook
events.why_it_matters: Second attempt to remove Fed Governor Cook after Supreme Court limited removal to 'for cause'; threatens Fed independence and could shift FOMC voting balance under hawkish Chair Warsh.
events.what_to_watch: Cook's response by Aug 26 deadline; potential Supreme Court test of Fed independence; market reaction to Fed politicization.

events.title: Trump announces $3B critical minerals mining deals
events.why_it_matters: State Department roundtable with Rio Tinto, BHP and others announces $3B in mining deals plus $180M for mining schools to counter China's critical minerals supply chain dominance.
events.what_to_watch: Specific project announcements; rare earth/copper/lithium supply implications; permitting reform signals.

events.title: OFAC sanctions crypto exchanges for IRGC support
events.why_it_matters: OFAC sanctioned Dubai-based Shelbit Exchange and Iran-based Aban Tether for processing funds to Iran's IRGC, expanding crypto sanctions enforcement into exchange infrastructure.
events.what_to_watch: Further crypto exchange designations; compliance ripple effects across the industry; Iran's crypto fundraising channels.

events.title: Senate schedules CLARITY Act cloture vote
events.why_it_matters: First full Senate vote on crypto market structure bill since House passed in July 2025; would clarify SEC vs CFTC jurisdiction and provide regulatory certainty for digital assets.
events.what_to_watch: Cloture vote outcome; community bank opposition over stablecoin rewards; potential amendments.

events.title: 30-year Treasury yield surges to 5.28% — highest since 2007
events.why_it_matters: 30-year yield hit 5.28%, highest since July 2006, as bond market doubts the Fed's hold under hawkish Chair Warsh; signals term premium expansion and potential mortgage/credit stress.
events.what_to_watch: Treasury auction demand (10yr/30yr); mortgage rate pass-through; equity valuation pressure from rising discount rates.

events.title: US-Japan joint yen-buying intervention — first in 15 years
events.why_it_matters: First US-Japan joint FX intervention since 2011, triggered by BOJ's Sept rate-hike signal; yen at 40-year lows; Treasury Secretary Bessent involvement signals coordinated policy response.
events.what_to_watch: Repeat intervention risk; USD/JPY at ~159 after giving back half the gains; BOJ September rate decision.

events.title: Applied Materials Q3 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Semiconductor equipment bellwether; guides AI/HBM capex cycle; stock up 106% YTD; revenue expected ~$9B.
events.what_to_watch: HBM revenue trajectory; China export-control impact; forward guidance for AI-driven equipment demand.

events.title: Cisco Q4 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Networking/AI infrastructure demand read; revenue expected ~$16.8B (+12% YoY) with networking revenue up 25%.
events.what_to_watch: AI networking orders; guidance for fiscal 2027; enterprise spending on AI infrastructure.

events.title: Taiwan conducts major live-fire military drill
events.why_it_matters: Taiwan tested internet throttling and drone defense in live-fire drill simulating Chinese assault amid heightened Taiwan Strait tensions and the Section 301 semiconductor probe.
events.what_to_watch: PLA response; semiconductor supply chain risk premium; US-Taiwan defense cooperation signals.

catcher.coverage_assessment: The primary scan was strong on scheduled macro data (CPI, PPI, retail sales, jobs) and mega-cap earnings (Nvidia, Walmart, Home Depot), and correctly identified Hormuz and Iran war as top geopolitical risks. However, it was nearly blind on government actions — missing the Senate's sweeping Russia/Iran sanctions bill, the Fed Governor Cook removal effort, the SEC's Reg Crypto vote, and the D.C. Circuit's separation-of-powers ruling — and under-covered the fixed income stress signal (30-year at 5.28%) and the historic US-Japan FX intervention.
catcher.biggest_gap: The Senate's passage of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (Aug 7) — a sweeping sanctions bill granting Trump authority to impose 100% tariffs on major buyers of Russian oil (India, China) — is the single most market-relevant missed event, directly impacting global oil flows, India/China trade relations, and energy prices.
